account_cost_id.description: Synthetic storage identifier for this account cost row.

account_id.description: AWS account identifier for the cost bucket, or the literal org-wide aggregate.

items.description: Map of grouping-dimension values to inline cost breakdown objects for this account.

total.description: Total cost for the account across all grouped items.

accounts_queried.description: Count of AWS account IDs included in the query.

aws_cost_result_id.description: Synthetic storage identifier for this AWS cost result.

group_by.description: Dimension used to group AWS costs.

period.description: Inline reporting period object for this result.

period_id.description: Identifier of the reporting period covered by this result.

total_cost.description: Total AWS cost across all returned accounts.

azure_cost_result_id.description: Synthetic storage identifier for this Azure cost result.

blobs_processed.description: Number of billing CSV blobs processed on the live path.

cache_last_refresh.description: Cache refresh marker from the billing cache, or unknown when unavailable.

meter_filter.description: Optional meter-category or subcategory filter echoed from the request.

note.description: Optional note, used for the no-matching-blobs live-path response.

period.description: Inline reporting period object for this result.

period_id.description: Identifier of the reporting period covered by this result.

results.description: Array of per-subscription Azure cost breakdowns.

source.description: Whether the result came from the local cache or live blob processing.

subscriptions_queried.description: Subscription selection summary; may be a count-like string, all, or a serialized list form depending on path.

total_cost.description: Total Azure cost across all returned subscriptions.

azure_service_cost_id.description: Synthetic storage identifier for this Azure service cost row.

cost.description: Total cost for the Azure meter category within a subscription.

meter_subcategories.description: Map of meter subcategory names to their summed costs.

azure_subscription_cost_id.description: Synthetic storage identifier for this Azure subscription cost row.

gpu_cost.description: Portion of the subscription total attributed to GPU-related usage.

services.description: Map of meter categories to inline Azure service cost objects.

subscription_name.description: Azure subscription name represented by this cost breakdown.

total.description: Total cost for the subscription across all services.

capacity_metric_result_id.description: Synthetic storage identifier for this capacity metric result.

capacity_totals_id.description: Identifier of the totals row associated with this result.

capacity_window_id.description: Identifier of the capacity window covered by this result.

group_by.description: Grouping dimension used for the capacity analysis.

metric.description: Metric preset requested for the capacity analysis.

period.description: Inline capacity window object for this result.

results.description: Array of per-dimension capacity metric entries.

totals.description: Inline totals object summarizing the returned capacity results.

capacity_totals_id.description: Synthetic storage identifier for this capacity totals row.

overall_utilization_pct.description: Overall utilization percentage across the included dimensions.

results_truncated.description: Whether the result list was truncated after exceeding the maximum returned entries.

total_dimensions.description: Count of surviving dimensions before any result-list truncation.

total_estimated_cost_usd.description: Estimated total cost across included dimensions.

transient_cost_usd.description: Unused estimated cost attributed to transient dimensions that were excluded.

transient_excluded.description: Count of transient dimensions excluded from the totals.

unused_estimated_cost_usd.description: Estimated unused cost across included dimensions.

capacity_window_id.description: Synthetic storage identifier for this capacity window.

end.description: End timestamp of the resolved capacity window in UTC date-time format.

start.description: Start timestamp of the resolved capacity window in UTC date-time format.

_dashboard_link.description: Optional dashboard URL attached by the wrapper service.

cost_monitor_result_id.description: Synthetic storage identifier for this cost monitor result.

endpoint.description: Cost-monitor endpoint this stored payload corresponds to.

results.description: Wrapped upstream array payload when a dashboard link is configured.

breakdown.description: Inline cost breakdown by the selected GCP grouping dimension.

daily_rows.description: Number of source billing rows returned by the query.

gcp_cost_result_id.description: Synthetic storage identifier for this GCP cost result.

group_by.description: Dimension used to group GCP costs.

period.description: Inline reporting period object for this result.

period_id.description: Identifier of the reporting period covered by this result.

total_cost.description: Total GCP cost across the reporting period.

end.description: End date of the reporting period in YYYY-MM-DD format.

period_id.description: Synthetic storage identifier for this reporting period.

start.description: Start date of the reporting period in YYYY-MM-DD format.
